name: homebrew-formula
body: Homebrew formula: the tap's `kalide` formula (`Formula/kalide.rb`, tap `really-knows-ai/kalide`) using `on_macos` + `on_arm`/`on_intel` blocks with plain `url "https://github.com/really-knows-ai/kalide/releases/download/v#{version}/kalide-darwin-<arch>"` + `sha256` — `kalide-darwin-arm64` on Apple silicon, `kalide-darwin-amd64` on Intel — fetched anonymously by Homebrew's default downloader from the public release. No custom download strategy (`Formula/lib/github_private_release_download_strategy.rb` is removed) and no `HOMEBREW_GITHUB_API_TOKEN`. The formula itself is unchanged by Homebrew 6.0.0+'s third-party trust requirement: trust is applied at the tap level by the user (`brew trust really-knows-ai/kalide`, required because the tap uses a custom remote, so the per-formula `brew trust --formula` form is refused), not inside the formula. The formula declares `license "Apache-2.0"`, consistent with requirements.requirement.license.
